name: Mebuki Financial Group,Inc.
summary: Mebuki Financial Group,Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking products and financial services in Japan and internationally. It accepts various deposits; and provides loans and securities investment. The company also engages in the leasing, securities, credit guarantee, credit card, real estate rental, investment, financial products intermediary, regional trading company, and renewable energy related businesses; software development; and research and consulting services. Mebuki Financial Group,Inc. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
